body: SECTION 145's own prerequisite note (found by the 2026-07-18 SAGA audit): emily-agent/fable.go (claude-haiku backlog advisor) collided with HQ-SPEC-AI-103's sovereign model-line FABLE. Renamed the advisor to MIMIR (Norse: the wise counsel-giver, matching NORN/SAGA/FATES) -- fable.go->mimir.go, FableAdvice/FableItem->MimirAdvice/MimirItem, routes /api/v1/emily/fable/*->/api/v1/emily/mimir/*. No external consumer depended on the old routes (checked MJOLNIR). docs/NORTHSTAR.md + docs/API_KEY_UNLOCK.md updated; a point-in-time experiment doc left as historical record. Build+tests green. Found a second, bigger, NOT-yet-resolved collision: this environment's real Claude model lineup includes an actual model called Fable (claude-fable-5) -- HQ-SPEC-AI-103's own FABLE branding collides with that too, flagged in BACKLOG.md for the founder since renaming an entire spec's established branding is a product decision, not mine to make unilaterally.
title: Resolved FABLE naming collision -- emily-agent advisor renamed to MIMIR
